## Introduction

This document is designed to help workshop participants to learn how to create reproducible documents using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).

It presents findings from exploratory analysis of data from Himes et al. 'RNA-Seq Transcriptome Profiling Identifies CRISPLD2 as a Glucocorticoid Responsive Gene that Modulates Cytokine Function in Airway Smooth Muscle Cells.'

PLoS One. 2014 Jun 13;9(6):e99625. PMID: 24926665. GEO: GSE52778.

## Methods

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Discussion

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
